decisions.reason: We would keep the premium raisin Christmas stollen because it is close to our core confectionery business, has been publicly highlighted, and its repeated gold awards strongly justify continued commitment.

We would keep the dark barley malt rye bread because it extends our traditional bread range, has remained visibly offered over two years, and any weaker-than-hoped traction can still be seen as a temporary market-acceptance issue rather than a reason to reverse course.

We would keep the marzipan Christmas stollen because it fits our established seasonal assortment, has been presented prominently in consecutive years, and dropping it now would undercut a publicly supported product line in which we have already invested.
